# Bottle Lake Bikes

> Bottle Lake Bikes is a local bike mechanic in Parklands, Christchurch, offering bike servicing, repairs, refurbished bike sales, and bike buying/selling support.

## About

Bottle Lake Bikes is run by Patrick and is located near Bottle Lake Forest in Parklands, Christchurch. The site describes bike servicing and repairs for mountain, road, gravel, commuter, and e-bikes, plus second-hand bike sales and bike buying/selling support.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://bottlelakebikes.co.nz/): Overview of Bottle Lake Bikes, its repair and servicing work, second-hand bike services, after-hours service note, and customer reviews.
- [Repairs and Servicing](https://bottlelakebikes.co.nz/services.html): Bike service packages, add-ons, individual service items, and pricing.
- [Buying and Selling](https://bottlelakebikes.co.nz/buying-selling.html): Information about buying refurbished bikes, selling a bike directly to Bottle Lake Bikes, or selling a bike on commission.
- [Bike Parts, Components and Accessory Brands](https://bottlelakebikes.co.nz/our-brands.html): Brands and product categories supplied for bikes, service parts, tyres, wheels, components, accessories, and riding gear.
- [About](https://bottlelakebikes.co.nz/about.html): Background on Patrick and the business approach.
- [Booking](https://bottlelakebikes.co.nz/booking.html): Online booking page for bike servicing, with a phone option for fastest service.
- [Contact](https://bottlelakebikes.co.nz/contact.html): Phone, email, address, opening hours, and contact form.

## Services

- [Repairs and Servicing](https://bottlelakebikes.co.nz/services.html): General Service, Full Service, drivetrain deep clean add-on, suspension and brake add-ons, individual repairs, and service pricing.
- [Booking](https://bottlelakebikes.co.nz/booking.html): Book a bike in for service online or call 021 0290 1656.
- [Buying and Selling](https://bottlelakebikes.co.nz/buying-selling.html): Buy refurbished bikes, sell a bike to Bottle Lake Bikes, or sell a bike through Bottle Lake Bikes on commission.
- [Our Brands](https://bottlelakebikes.co.nz/our-brands.html): Ask about replacement parts, tyres, tubes, brake pads, drivetrain parts, wheel components, riding accessories, and listed bike brands.
